paper_title: Constraints on axion-like polarization oscillations in the cosmic microwave background with POLARBEAR
notes: POLARBEAR CMB birefringence oscillation search over two seasons (2012-2014). No signal detected; median 95% CL upper limit of 0.65 deg on sinusoid amplitude for f = 0.02-0.45 /day, corresponding to axion masses 9.6e-22 to 2.2e-20 eV. Primary (stochastic) result: g_phigamma < 2.4e-11 GeV^-1 x (m_phi/1e-21 eV), a limit linear in mass. Data points generated from this analytic median-limit formula evaluated across the stated mass validity range (the exact bound oscillates around this median but is only shown in Fig. 5). Deterministic-case limit (1.1e-11 GeV^-1 x m/1e-21 eV) also reported but the stochastic result is the paper's primary constraint.
